items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: his name was Johnny Gary, another guy who I really became good friends with.

ctx.x: Europe, because financially the money wasn't big enough to carry a trio. And I really regretted to have to leave these fellows. But Sarah went to Europe with just her and her husband and the valet -- his name was Johnny Gary, another guy who I really became good friends with. The four of us went. We boarded the Liberte and went to London from New York, which proved to be at that particular time I think about a three-and-a-half-day trip.

Anyway, we arrived at London and we were greeted just like what we felt like was royalty, because there were people waiting at the train station, and we were treated very well, taken to the hotels and given every courtesy. The London media and the agents and everything... Everything was just beautiful.
